idea:
Remove the incomplete MCP (Model Context Protocol) server implementation that adds maintenance burden without providing meaningful value.

## What needs to be done

Remove all MCP-related code from the codebase:
- Delete `src/mcp/` module and all files within it
- Remove MCP-related CLI subcommands (e.g., `ralph mcp`)
- Delete MCP handler tests in `tests/mcp_handlers.rs`
- Remove MCP-related imports, registrations, and wiring from `src/main.rs`, `src/cli/`, and `src/lib.rs`
- Clean up MCP-related dependencies in `Cargo.toml` if they become unused after removal

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] All MCP code is removed
- [ ] `nix build` passes (release build + conformance tests)
- [ ] No dead code warnings related to MCP leftovers
- [ ] No remaining references to MCP in source code (except possibly changelog/docs)
